prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Story First Auth Reordering: Reorder the onboarding flow so users pick their pet and path first before signing in to back up their creation. (why: Asking for sign-in before picking a pet causes friction early. Placing sign_in after pet selection leverages commitment.)
1: [home, wait_info] Companion Trait Discovery Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel with sound previews on the waiting screen to keep users engaged while generation occurs. (why: Home wait time is very long (mean 2336s / median 201s), causing users to abandon the application during render.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Background Ready Chime Prompt: Enable ready notifications and display a background completion audio chime setting on the waiting screen. (why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) lead to users leaving the computer or missing when generation completes.)

scores.note: Reordering auth builds user commitment before requiring account creation.
Interactive content engages users during the extreme wait time on the home step.
Background audio chimes bring users back after long generation delays.
